transformer.name: application-json
transformer.title: Application Json
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to binary (byte array) using Jackson 3

transformerIn.description: A Json object or array as text, bytes or a stream, a Map, a List, a JsonNode or a POJO; other text, also a Json number, boolean, null or quoted string, becomes a Json string; bytes and a stream are read as text with the exchange charset, so a payload that is not text must be encoded first, such as in Base64, or given a content class; with the X-Content-Class exchange property only a Json object or array as text or a body of that class; a null body becomes null
